recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3274 unless a future work group decision changes Patient.contact.period semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-3274 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request asking to add a Patient.contact.period element because patient contacts can change over a time period, including v2 NK1-8/NK1-9 next-of-kin start and end dates.
initial_application: The legacy Patient spreadsheet was updated in commit 5415ea6b967c8ea57da1ac0aa8743b04aa7867e6, whose message explicitly says Task #3274 Patient.Contact.Period was applied again; the row became Patient.contact.period with 0..1 cardinality and Period type. The 2021 source rework then carried that element into source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines Patient.contact.period with a validity-period short/definition and RIM effectiveTime mapping. Later Jira FHIR-16592 was Resolved - No Change because Patient.contact already had a period. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the requested element is already present in the current authoritative Patient StructureDefinition and editing would be redundant.

related_jiras.note: A later Resolved - No Change Patient issue states Patient.contact already has a period, confirming no additional date element was needed.
